design_method_notes: Do not extrapolate a room-temperature yield value to elevated-temperature design.
For thermal strain, use integral of CTE over the temperature interval when accuracy requires it.
For constrained structures, thermal expansion and temperature-dependent modulus must be considered together.
Cryogenic use requires alloy- and condition-specific toughness/ductility evidence rather than generic low-temperature assumptions.
